1.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
1.comment: 2ND REPEAT: Observed there was not a Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM) present at the facility when the inspector arrived. CORRECTED: During the inspection a CFPM arrived at the facility. The inspector suggests current employees get CFPM certification to ensure that there is always a CFPM present during all hours of food preparation, handling, and service.

2.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
2.comment: Observed that the facility does not have signed Employee Health Reporting Agreements available. CORRECTED: PIC was notified and employees completed the Employee Health Reporting Agreements during the inspection. Ensure the food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report information about their health as it relates to food safety.

3.title: Food separated and protected.
3.comment: Inspector observed an unsealed package of hot dogs to be stored in direct contact with a personal take-out bag of fast food. The PIC was informed that this storage method is hazardous due cross contamination. The hot dogs were sealed and moved to a safe position in the cooler during today’s visit. Ensure personal items are stored below food for the consumer or in a non-permeable container to prevent cross-contamination.

4.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
4.comment: Insepctor observed no stem thermometer available at the facility for measuring the temperature of time/temperature control for safety foods. The staff member present was informed, and he stated that the thermometer has been ordered. The inspector will follow-up on December 4, 2026 to ensure a stem thermometer is available.

5.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
5.comment:
Observed the following nonfood-contact surfaces with an accumulation of soil residues and ice:
(i) the mini display cooler has an accumulation of ice in the back of the cooler.
(ii) the undersides of the juice dispenser have an accumulation of soils from splashes.
PIC was notified. Ensure that nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment are cleaned at a frequency to prevent an accumulation of soil residues.
